entries.title: Two new hacking minigames
entries.summary: Packet Switchboard and Prism Lock join the HoloSuite Hacking lineup, adding new packet-routing and optical-ring challenges with configurable difficulty profiles.

entries.title: Multiple scenes per star system
entries.summary: Galaxy Map systems can now link to multiple Foundry scenes, making it easier to organize and navigate locations across a campaign.

entries.title: Phantom token projections cleaned up
entries.summary: Camera feeds now filter token projections more reliably, preventing stale or hidden phantom tokens from appearing in live security views.

entries.title: Richer messages and notifications
entries.summary: CyberCall messaging now features clearer incoming notifications and improved image support, making conversations easier to follow and character identities more visually distinct.

entries.title: Bounty Board adopts HoloSuite styling
entries.summary: Bounty Board is now integrated with HoloSuite's shared visual system, delivering a more cohesive look and feel across the suite.

entries.title: Evidence images open from item cards
entries.summary: Evidence image controls now open their full image previews from CSI item cards, making case-board evidence easier to inspect at the table.

entries.title: Expanded launcher integration
entries.summary: HoloSuite Core adds launcher support for HoloSuite Terminal and keeps the Updates feed focused on the latest module improvements.

entries.title: Interactive sci-fi terminals join HoloSuite
entries.summary: Turn terminals into playable locations with configurable mail, files, camera feeds, utilities, authentication, hacking, permissions, encounter-driven downloads, and distinct visual themes.

entries.title: Cinematic scanner pulses join HoloSuite
entries.summary: Reveal GM-placed scan targets with a table-ready scanner pulse, visibility controls, range handling, and system-agnostic target data.

entries.title: Ship loadouts join HoloSuite
entries.summary: Create system-agnostic ship profiles with equipment slots, power allocation, damage tracking, ship-image pins, and player-facing install or activation permissions.
